title: An Ahmed-like integral
summary: The so-called Ahmed integral $$ \int_{0}^{1}\frac{\arctan\left(\sqrt{2+x^{2}}\right)}{(1+x^{2})\sqrt{2+x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d} x=\frac{5π^{2}}{96}, $$ has attracted considerable interest since its appearance in the "American Mathematical Monthly" in 2001. Several proofs and extensions have been proposed, including a probabilistic multivariate approach introduced by Pla based on powers of the Gaussian integral.
